notes: After you log a payment, the “Where your extra goes” card now shows what you have logged to that debt this month and what the plan still has going to it, for example “$420 logged in October · $1,260 still planned”. It used to appear only in the last 10 days of the month.
In the last 10 days of the month that line adds “Your Freedom Date counts on it”, and once the month’s planned amount is logged it says so.
